basis.scoring: this league's scoring settings (half-PPR with IDP)
basis.position_rule: every position a player is eligible at in Sleeper (a DL/LB player is ranked in both lists; the label shown is his primary position); DE/DT count as DL, CB/S as DB, OLB/ILB as LB
basis.ties: equal totals are ordered by player id
basis.source: Sleeper NFL stats (stats-array) scored locally, league scores where rostered
